verdict.rationale: Openness of source is a fair question for a cloud platform, since providers can publish components such as their Terraform provider or clients under open licenses. The evidence pack, however, never mentions a public source repository or an open-source license for any CoreWeave component. The Terraform provider and generated API clients are documented only as tools to use, not as source code available to read under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
